## Preview while you write

```bash
quarto preview
```

The page reloads when you save. The pre-render script runs first, so the home page and module pages are always current.

## Render the site

```bash
quarto render
```

Because `output-dir` is `.`, the HTML lands next to the sources, which is how the `courses/` repo is served: `statmania.info/courses/<slug>/`.

## Before you publish

- [ ] Every lesson has `title`, `description`, `minutes` and `kind`.
- [ ] Every lesson has a quiz or a takeaways block.
- [ ] `index.qmd` outcomes match what the lessons actually teach.
- [ ] Course appears in the hub page `courses/index.html`.
- [ ] Previous and next links walk the lessons in the right order.
